next_question.rationale: Play Store signals and the reason clusters point at consultation / prescription flows (treatment expiry, erx expired). Cutting by whether the plan began with a doctor consultation should reveal if consultation-driven plans are failing to reach “paid for the plan” because prescriptions expire or doctors/community steps leak before payment; if so, this explains a large share of the 6,319 lost creations and points to fixes in the consultation->payment handoff.
